title: Kernel selector v2: add registry entry for Qwen family (L4/A10/A100/H100)
author: Grace Kim
description:
Context
We’re rolling out kernel auto-selection v2 with a table-driven registry keyed by {model_family, seq_bucket, gpu_sku_normalized, dtype, gqa_flag}. Qwen-family models are now a common workload in Hosted (especially EU) and Dedicated evals, and were previously falling back to the generic Llama-family profile or the safe-kernel set depending on metadata completeness. That produced avoidable variance on L4/A10 and left throughput on A100/H100 on the table for long-context prefill.

This PR adds first-class registry entries for Qwen-family across L4/A10/A100/H100 and the standard seq buckets, using benchmark-lab data from the last two sweeps. It does NOT change selection logic; it only extends the registry table and adds lightweight validation tests.

What’s included
- Adds model_family=QWEN to the kernel registry and maps Qwen2 / Qwen2.5 (dense + GQA variants) into that family when metadata is present.
- Adds tuned kernel ids per GPU SKU for both prefill and decode regimes with explicit seq buckets.
- Adds guardrails so Qwen entries never select kernels outside the “safe set” for unknown head_dim configurations.
- Updates registry schema docs/comments to clarify Qwen dtype defaults (bf16 preferred when available; fp16 allowed on L4/A10).

Registry entries (high level)
Buckets (consistent with selector v2 defaults):
- prefill_short: effective_ctx <= 2k
- prefill_long: 2k < effective_ctx <= 8k
- prefill_xlong: effective_ctx > 8k
- decode: decode_step

GPUs:
- L4: prefers fused-attn v3 for prefill_short/long; falls back to flash-attn v2 for xlong due to observed workspace pressure at 16k prefill.
- A10: similar to L4 but uses a conservative kernel for prefill_xlong (avoid p95 spikes seen in earlier canary).
- A100: uses flash-attn v3 for all prefill buckets; decode stays on the existing paged-kv decode kernel.
- H100: uses flash-attn v3 + warp-specialized kernels for prefill_long/xlong; decode uses the h100-optimized decode kernel when head_dim matches supported set.

Benchmarks (summary)
Measured on benchmark-lab sweep 2026-02-09 (internal artifact: benchlab/run/118772):
- Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, mixed prompt dist (p50 512 tok, p95 8k tok), batch=auto
  - L4: p95 improved 7–11% vs generic llama-family entry; tok/s +6%.
  - A10: p95 improved 4–8%; reduced variance between runs (stddev down ~30%).
  - A100: prefill tok/s +9–13% for long-context prompts.
  - H100: prefill tok/s +10–16% for prefill_long/xlong.

- Qwen2.5-32B (Dedicated-like long-context)
  - A100/H100: best gains in prefill_long/xlong; decode largely unchanged.

No correctness diffs observed in conformance suite (see CI).

Files changed (high level)
- runtime/kernels/registry/registry_v1.yaml
  - Adds QWEN family entries across GPUs + seq buckets
- runtime/kernels/registry/model_family_map.go
  - Maps Qwen2/Qwen2.5 metadata to QWEN family
- runtime/kernels/registry/registry_validate_test.go
  - Adds sanity tests for Qwen entries (no unknown kernel ids; required buckets present)
- runtime/docs/kernel_registry.md
  - Notes on Qwen dtype expectations + head_dim guardrails

Illustrative snippet (registry_v1.yaml)
QWEN:
  gqa:true:
    bf16:
      L4:
        prefill_short: attn_fused_v3_l4
        prefill_long:  attn_fused_v3_l4
        prefill_xlong: attn_flash_v2_l4
        decode:        decode_pagedkv_generic
      H100:
        prefill_short: attn_flash_v3_h100
        prefill_long:  attn_flash_v3_ws_h100
        prefill_xlong: attn_flash_v3_ws_h100
        decode:        decode_ws_h100

Rollout/ops notes
- This is registry-only; rollout is controlled by selector v2 flag.
- If we see regressions limited to Qwen, SRE can pin family=QWEN to the previous safe kernels via the override mechanism (runbook references ENG-3931).

Checklist
- [x] Benchmarked across L4/A10/A100/H100
- [x] Conformance tests passed for representative shapes
- [x] Registry validation test added
- [x] Cardinality impact: none (no new metric labels)

Review conversation (abridged)
Yuki Sato (requested changes): On L4/A10, can we avoid selecting fused v3 for prefill_xlong? We’ve seen allocator churn at 16k+ prefill with that kernel.
Grace Kim (author): Agreed. Updated prefill_xlong to flash v2 for L4 and a conservative v2 path for A10. Added a comment referencing the earlier A10 long-context p95 spike.

Noah Patel: Does the Qwen family include both dense and MoE variants? If MoE starts landing, we should ensure we don’t accidentally classify it here.
Grace Kim: Family mapping intentionally only matches known dense Qwen2/Qwen2.5 architecture strings. Unknown/experimental stays UNKNOWN -> safe-kernel set. Added a unit test for a mock “qwen-moe” arch string to ensure it does not map.

Thomas Baird: Please confirm we’re not expanding metric cardinality; also, registry keys should not include raw model name.
Grace Kim: Confirmed. Registry selection is keyed by model_family + normalized gpu sku + seq_bucket + dtype + gqa. No model_name tags. No telemetry changes in this PR.

Rina Kobayashi: Can you attach the benchmark-lab run and note the prompt distribution used?
Grace Kim: Added benchlab run id + distribution summary to PR description and included a link in the commit message.
